name: celld
readme_excerpt: celld Self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects. celld is an open-source daemon that runs a Cloudflare Workers application on your own machines: Workers, Durable Objects, KV, Queues, D1, R2, Workflows, Cron Triggers, and static assets, deployed from the wrangler.json that you already have. Each object is a cell: a named server with its own SQLite database. celld stores the long-term state in your S3-compatible, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage bucket. It needs no serving control plane…
